method: Poppler 26.10.0 SVG; four baseline vertices and four eight-vertex warming curves; separately calibrated linear temperature axes and log methane axis

conditions.surface: aquaplanet, 50 m slab ocean, explicit clouds and simplified ice albedo

precision: Decimals retain vector calibration; not physical uncertainty or raw GCM output precision
interpretation: Absolute temperature = plotted zero-methane baseline + plotted methane warming increment. No cross-model stitching, offset fitting or coupling has been performed.
source_retention: PDF and rendered source figure remain under gitignored local/sources/eager_nash2023
